settingsStyles.heading: Response styles
settingsStyles.intro: A style is appended to the system prompt of every turn in a session — it changes tone and formatting only. Your own styles are Markdown files in
settingsStyles.mine.heading: My styles
settingsStyles.mine.empty: No styles of your own yet. Create one, or copy a built-in and edit it.
settingsStyles.overrides.hint: A style of yours with the same id wins over the built-in one.
settingsStyles.builtIn.heading: Built-in styles
settingsStyles.builtIn.desc: Shipped with the app and always available. To change one, copy it and edit your copy — your version wins over the built-in.
settingsStyles.builtIn.copy: Copy into a style of mine
settingsStyles.editor.name: Name
settingsStyles.editor.descriptionHint: One line — what this style is for
settingsStyles.editor.bodyHint: Write it as an instruction to the model, e.g. "Answer in short sentences. No preamble. Code unchanged."
settingsStyles.editor.overrideNote: This id matches a built-in style — yours will be used instead.
settingsStyles.delete.title: Delete this style?
settingsStyles.delete.body: "{name}" will be deleted from disk. Sessions still set to it fall back to no style (or to the built-in one of the same id).
settingsStyles.error.idInvalid: Id may only contain lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_' (max 64).
